Mod.Name: Friendly Progression
Mod.Author: Overgrowth Online
Mod.Description: Spend XP between campaign levels or Arena matches. The host can also enable free upgrades at checkpoints and Arena round ends. Each player's Luck affects their chance to get a choice and the value of the four upgrades offered. Saves keep balances, equipment, Luck and pending choices with their lobby slots.

LobbySetting.label: Progression
LobbySetting.description: Configure XP, the shop and free upgrades for this mode.

LobbySetting.label: XP shop
LobbySetting.description: Spend earned XP on upgrades after each completed campaign level or Arena match.

LobbySetting.label: Free upgrade choice
LobbySetting.description: At each new campaign checkpoint or Arena round end, each player has a chance to pick one of four free upgrades. Luck improves that chance and the odds of drawing expensive upgrades.

LobbySetting.label: Upgrades
LobbySetting.description: Buy upgrades independently or share them across a team.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP for damage dealt
LobbySetting.description: Earn XP in proportion to the damage you deal to opponents.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP for kills
LobbySetting.description: Earn an opponent's bounty when your team defeats them.

LobbySetting.label: Lose pooled XP on damage
LobbySetting.description: Taking damage reduces your unbanked XP, down to zero. In Arena, combat XP banks at the end of each round when this is enabled.

LobbySetting.label: Lose XP on defeat
LobbySetting.description: Defeat spends pooled XP first. Any unpaid cost comes from committed XP. In Arena, combat XP banks at the end of each round when this is enabled.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP at checkpoints
LobbySetting.description: Earn bonus XP for reaching a new campaign checkpoint.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP for round wins
LobbySetting.description: Earn bonus XP when your team wins an Arena round, including the final round.

LobbySetting.label: Gain XP for match wins
LobbySetting.description: Earn bonus XP when your team wins an Arena match.

LobbySetting.label: Multiplayer upgrade timer
LobbySetting.description: Set how long the multiplayer shop waits for players to finish shopping.
